newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end slightly up in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end slightly up in light trade.

text.p: Thai stocks closed slightly up on Monday in quiet trade as investors remained reluctant to enter the market ahead of the November 17 general election, brokers said.
The SET index closed up 0.45 points at 912.97 with 1.68 billion baht trade. The SET-50 index finised down 0.05 points to 68.87.
"Most investors appeared to stop trading shares. Their attention is now on the coming election," said a broker at United Securities.
Brokers said there was continued selling of some finance shares due to persistent worry about whether they may be hit by defaults on loans granted to property firms in trouble.
"Trading tomorrow is expected to remain sluggish because the political picture is still unclear," the broker said.
National Finance was off 0.75 baht to 48.25 on the most active turnover of 61 million baht.
Bangkok Bank was unchanged at 94 and Krung Thai Bank fell one 69.
Advanced Info Services was down 10 to 340. TelecomASia was unchanged at 48.50. -- Anuchit Nguyen (662) 652-0642
